description: This PHP source file handles the display and management of subpanel views within the SuiteCRM application. It processes request parameters, initializes subpanel components, loads definitions, and renders the subpanel interface with optional inline or popup modes.

classes.name: SubPanel
classes.description: Represents a subpanel component responsible for displaying related records within a module.

classes.name: SubPanelDefinitions
classes.description: Handles loading and managing subpanel layout definitions for modules.

classes.name: jsAlerts
classes.description: Handles JavaScript alert scripting for the user interface.

methods.name: load_subpanel
methods.description: Loads the subpanel layout definition based on parameters.

methods.name: setTemplateFile
methods.description: Sets the template file used for rendering the subpanel.

methods.name: get_buttons
methods.description: Generates the HTML for action buttons in the subpanel.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the subpanel data, optionally returning only count.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript needed for alert popups.
